verses.en: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
verses.pt: E enquanto Esdras estava orando, confessando, chorando, e prostrando-se diante da casa de Deus, ajuntou-se a ele uma multidão muito grande de israelitas, homens, mulheres, e crianças; pois o povo chorava muito.
verses.en_web: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.
verses.en_bbe: Now while Ezra was making his prayer and his statement of wrongdoing, weeping and falling down before the house of God, a very great number of men and women and children out of Israel came together round him: for the people were weeping bitterly.

verses.en: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
verses.pt: Então Secanias, filho de Jeiel, dos filhos de Elão, respondeu a Esdras, dizendo: Nós temos transgredido contra nosso Deus, pois nos casamos com mulheres estrangeiras dos povos da terra; mas quanto a isto, ainda há esperança para Israel.
verses.en_web: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.
verses.en_bbe: And Shecaniah, the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answering, said to Ezra, We have done evil against our God, and have taken as our wives strange women of the peoples of the land: but still there is hope for Israel in this question.

verses.en: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, façamos um pacto com o nosso Deus, de que despediremos todas as mulheres e os todos os nascidos delas, conforme o conselho do Senhor, e dos que tremem ao mandamento de nosso Deus; e faça-se conforme à lei.
verses.en_web: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and those who as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.
verses.en_bbe: Let us now make an agreement with our God to put away all the wives and all their children, if it seems right to my lord and to those who go in fear of the words of our God; and let it be done in keeping with the law.

verses.en: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, porque cabe a ti este negócio, e nós seremos contigo; esforça-te, e age.
verses.en_web: Arise; for the matter belongs to you, and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”
verses.en_bbe: Up, now! for this is your business, and we are with you; take heart and do it.

verses.en: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
verses.pt: Então Esdras se levantou, e fez os chefes dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, e a todo Israel, jurarem que fariam conforme essa palavra; e eles juraram.
verses.en_web: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.
verses.en_bbe: Then Ezra got up, and made the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and all Israel take an oath that they would do this. So they took an oath.

verses.en: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
verses.pt: E Esdras se levantou de diante da casa de Deus, e entrou na câmara de Joanã, filho de Eliasibe; e depois de chegar lá, não comeu pão nem bebeu água, porque estava entristecido pela transgressão dos que eram do cativeiro.
verses.en_web: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he ate no bread, nor drank water; for he mourned because of their trespass of the captivity.
verses.en_bbe: Then Ezra got up from before the house of God and went into the room of Jehohanan, the son of Eliashib; but when he came there, he took no food or drink, for he was sorrowing for the sin of those who had come back.

verses.en: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
verses.pt: Então proclamaram em Judá e em Jerusalém a todos os que vieram do cativeiro, que se reunissem em Jerusalém;
verses.en_web: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;
verses.en_bbe: And they made a public statement through all Judah and Jerusalem, to all those who had come back, that they were to come together to Jerusalem;

verses.en: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.
verses.pt: E que de todo aquele que não viesse em três dias, segundo o conselho dos príncipes e dos anciãos, fosse tomada toda a sua riqueza, e ele fosse separado da comunidade dos do cativeiro.
verses.en_web: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.
verses.en_bbe: And that if anyone did not come before three days were past, as ordered by the rulers and the responsible men, all his goods would be put under the curse, and he himself would be cut off from the meeting of the people who had come back.

verses.en: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
verses.pt: Então todos os homens de Judá e de Benjamim se reuniram em Jerusalém em três dias, aos vinte do mês, no nono mês; e todo o povo se sentou na praça da casa de Deus, tremendo por causa deste negócio, e por causa das grandes chuvas.
verses.en_web: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.
verses.en_bbe: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin came together to Jerusalem before three days were past; it was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people were seated in the wide square in front of the house of God, shaking with fear because of this business and because of the great rain.

verses.en: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
verses.pt: Assim o sacerdote Esdras se levantou, e lhes disse: Vós transgredistes, por terdes se casado com mulheres estrangeiras, aumentando assim a culpa de Israel.
verses.en_web: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, to increase the guilt of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Ezra the priest got to his feet and said to them, You have done wrong and taken strange women for your wives, so increasing the sin of Israel.

verses.en: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, confessai ao SENHOR, Deus de vossos pais, e fazei a sua vontade, e separai-vos dos povos das terras, e das mulheres estrangeiras.
verses.en_web: Now therefore make confession to Yahweh, the God of your fathers, and do his pleasure; and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land, and from the foreign women.”
verses.en_bbe: So now, give praise to the Lord, the God of your fathers, and do his pleasure; and make yourselves separate from the peoples of the land and from the strange women.

verses.en: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
verses.pt: E toda a congregação respondeu, dizendo em alta voz: Assim se faça, conforme a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “As you have said concerning us, so must we do.
verses.en_bbe: Then all the people, answering, said with a loud voice, As you have said, so it is right for us to do.

verses.en: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
verses.pt: Porém o povo é muito, e o tempo chuvoso, e não há condições de ficar fora das casas; nem esta obra é de um dia ou de dois, porque somos muitos os que transgredimos neste negócio.
verses.en_web: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.
verses.en_bbe: But the number of people is great, and it is a time of much rain; it is not possible for us to go on waiting outside, and this is not a thing which may be done in one day or even two: for our sin in this business is great.

verses.en: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
verses.pt: Portanto fiquem encarregados nossos príncipes por toda a congregação; e todos os que em nossas cidades que houverem se casado com mulheres estrangeiras, venham a tempos determinados, e com eles os anciãos de cada cidade, e seus juízes, até que desviemos de nós o ardor da ira de nosso Deus por esta causa.
verses.en_web: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”
verses.en_bbe: So now let our rulers be representatives for all the people, and let all those in our towns who are married to strange women come at fixed times, and with them the responsible men and the judges of every town, till the burning wrath of our God is turned away from us, and this has been done.

verses.en: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.pt: Somente Jônatas, filho de Asael, e Jazeias, filho de Ticvá, apoiados por Mesulão e o levita Sabetai, se opuseram a isso.
verses.en_web: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.en_bbe: Only Jonathan, the son of Asahel, and Jahzeiah, the son of Tikvah, were against this, Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supporting them.

verses.en: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.pt: E assim fizeram os que vieram do cativeiro; e foram separados pelo sacerdote Esdras os homens, chefes de famílias, segundo a casa de seus pais, todos eles por nomes, para se sentarem ao dia primeiro do mês décimo, para investigarem este negócio.
verses.en_web: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.en_bbe: So those who had come back did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain heads of families, by their fathers' families, all of them by their names, were marked out; and on the first day of the tenth month they took their places to go into the question with care.

verses.en: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.pt: E ao primeiro dia do mês primeiro, terminaram de investigar os homens que haviam se casado com mulheres estrangeiras.
verses.en_web: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.
verses.en_bbe: And they got to the end of all the men who were married to strange women by the first day of the first month.

verses.en: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.pt: E dos filhos dos sacerdotes que haviam se casado com mulheres estrangeiras, foram achados estes: dos filhos de Jesua, filho de Jozadaque, e de seus irmãos: Maaseias, Eliézer, Jaribe, e Gedalias;
verses.en_web: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers, Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.en_bbe: And among the sons of the priests who were married to strange women were these: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak and his brothers, Maaseiah and Eliezer and Jarib and Gedaliah.

verses.en: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
verses.pt: E prometeram despedir suas mulheres e, reconhecendo sua culpa, ofereceram um carneiro do rebanho pela transgressão deles.
verses.en_web: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave their word that they would put away their wives; and for their sin, they gave an offering of a male sheep of the flock.

verses.en: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Imer: Hanani e Zebadias.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Immer, Hanani and Zebadiah.

verses.en: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.pt: E do filhos de Harim, Maaseias, Elias, Semaías, Jeiel, e Uzias.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Harim, Maaseiah and Elijah and Shemaiah and Jehiel and Uzziah.

verses.en: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Pasur: Elioenai, Maaseias, Ismael, Natanael, Jozabade, e Elasá.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Pashhur, Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

verses.en: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.pt: E dos filhos dos levitas: Jozabade, Simei, Quelaías (este é Quelita), Petaías, Judá, e Eliézer.
verses.en_web: Of the Levites: Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.en_bbe: And of the Levites, Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah (that is Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

verses.en: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.pt: E dos cantores: Eliasibe; e dos porteiros: Salum, Telém, e Uri.
verses.en_web: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.en_bbe: And of the music-makers, Eliashib; and of the door-keepers, Shallum and Telem and Uri.

verses.en: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
verses.pt: E dos demais israelitas: Dos filhos de Parós: Ramias, Jezias, Malquias, Miamim, Eleazar, e Malquias, e Benaías.
verses.en_web: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, and Izziah, and Malchijah, and Mijamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
verses.en_bbe: And of Israel, the sons of Parosh, Ramiah and Izziah and Malchijah and Mijamin and Eleazar and Malchijah and Benaiah.

verses.en: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Elão: Matanias, Zacarias, Jeiel, Abdi, Jeremote, Elias.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Elijah.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Elam, Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel and Abdi and Jeremoth and Elijah.

verses.en: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Zatu: Elioenai, Eliasibe, Matanias, e Jeremote, Zabade, e Aziza.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Zattu, Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth and Zabad and Aziza.

verses.en: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Bebai: Jeoanã, Hananias, Zabai, Atlai.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Bebai, Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.

verses.en: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Bani: Mesulão, Maluque, Adaías, Jasube, Seal, e Jeremote.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, Jeremoth.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Bani, Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub and Sheal, Jeremoth.

verses.en: And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Paate-Moabe: Adna, Quelal, Benaías, Maaseias, Matanias, Bezalel, Binui e Manassés.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Pahath-moab, Adna and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel and Binnui and Manasseh.

verses.en: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Harim: Eliézer, Issias, Malquias, Semaías, Simeão,
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
verses.en_bbe: And of the sons of Harim, Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

verses.en: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
verses.pt: Benjamim, Maluque, e Semarias.
verses.en_web: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.
verses.en_bbe: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.

verses.en: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Hasum: Matenai, Matatá, Zabade, Elifelete, Jeremai, Manassés, Simei.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Hashum, Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.

verses.en: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Bani: Maadai, Anrão, Uel,
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Bani, Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

verses.en: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
verses.pt: Benaías, Bedias, Queluí,
verses.en_web: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
verses.en_bbe: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

verses.en: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
verses.pt: Vanias, Meremote, Eliasibe,
verses.en_web: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
verses.en_bbe: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

verses.en: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
verses.pt: Matanias, Matenai, e Jaasai,
verses.en_web: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu,
verses.en_bbe: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu,

verses.en: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
verses.pt: E Bani, e Binui, Simei,
verses.en_web: and Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
verses.en_bbe: And Bani and Binnui, Shimei;

verses.en: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
verses.pt: Selemias, Natã, Adaías,
verses.en_web: and Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
verses.en_bbe: And Shelemiah and Nathan and Adaiah,

verses.en: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
verses.pt: Macnadbai, Sasai, Sarai,
verses.en_web: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
verses.en_bbe: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

verses.en: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
verses.pt: Azareel, Selemias, Semarias,
verses.en_web: Azarel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
verses.en_bbe: Azarel and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

verses.en: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
verses.pt: Salum, Amarias, José.
verses.en_web: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.

verses.en: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
verses.pt: E dos filhos de Nebo: Jeiel, Matitias, Zabade, Zebina, Jadai, Joel, e Benaías.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, and Joel, Benaiah.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Nebo, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, and Joel, Benaiah.

verses.en: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
verses.pt: Todos estes haviam tomado mulheres estrangeiras; e alguns deles tiveram filhos com tais mulheres.
verses.en_web: All these had taken foreign wives; and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
verses.en_bbe: All these had taken strange wives; and some of them had wives by whom they had offspring.
